chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Wahb ibn Hafs, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who performs sajdah upon a coarse cloth, and he said: If he is in taqiyyah, then there is no harm.

key_terms.الْمِسْحِ: a coarse cloth or fabric upon which prostration is being made
key_terms.تَقِيَّةٍ: religious precaution or dissimulation in a situation of risk
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or no objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform sajdah on cloth during taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning performing sajdah on a material normally not used for prostration. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that when a person is in taqiyyah, there is no problem in doing so, indicating a concession under circumstances of dissimulation or precaution.
